places.name: Dal Lake
places.description: The soul of Srinagar — a living, working floating city that is utterly unlike anywhere else on Earth.
places.mapsSearch: Dal Lake, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India
places.bestTime: April to October; December to January for snow-dusted houseboats

places.name: Gulmarg
places.description: Asia's best ski destination by altitude, and India's most spectacular alpine meadow in summer.
places.mapsSearch: Gulmarg, Baramulla, Jammu and Kashmir, India
places.bestTime: December to March for skiing; May to September for summer activities

places.name: Mughal Gardens (Shalimar, Nishat, Chashme Shahi)
places.description: The finest Mughal garden complex outside Agra, alive with chinars, fountains, and mountain reflections.
places.mapsSearch: Shalimar Bagh, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India
places.bestTime: April to June (spring flowers); October (chinar autumn foliage)

places.name: Sonamarg
places.description: Kashmir's most spectacular valley road, with a glacier, wildflower meadows, and the gateway to the Great Himalayan spine.
places.mapsSearch: Sonamarg, Ganderbal, Jammu and Kashmir, India

places.name: Pahalgam
places.description: Kashmir's most beautiful riverside hill town, base for the Amarnath pilgrimage and Bollywood's favourite backdrop.
places.mapsSearch: Pahalgam, Anantnag, Jammu and Kashmir, India

places.name: Hazratbal Shrine
places.description: Kashmir's most revered Muslim shrine, home to a sacred relic of the Prophet, on the shores of Dal Lake.
places.mapsSearch: Hazratbal Shrine, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India
places.bestTime: Year-round; Eid dates for relic display

places.name: Shankaracharya Temple
places.description: The best panoramic viewpoint in Srinagar, atop a sacred Shiva temple perched on a dramatic volcanic pinnacle.
places.mapsSearch: Shankaracharya Temple, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India
places.bestTime: Year-round; dawn and dusk for light

places.name: Yusmarg
places.description: Kashmir's most unspoiled highland meadow, far quieter than Pahalgam, with glacier day-treks from camp.
places.mapsSearch: Yusmarg, Budgam, Jammu and Kashmir, India

places.name: Amarnath Cave
places.description: One of Hinduism's most revered pilgrimage sites, a naturally formed ice Shivalingam at near-4,000 metres.
places.mapsSearch: Amarnath Cave, Anantnag, Jammu and Kashmir, India

places.name: Wular Lake
places.description: Asia's largest freshwater lake, a vast bird haven and cultural landscape of floating reed islands.
places.mapsSearch: Wular Lake, Bandipora, Jammu and Kashmir, India
places.bestTime: October to March for migratory birds
